by
  intro K _inst1 V _inst3 _inst4 _inst5 n i j t h ht
  exact
    by
      constructor
      · intro hz; apply ht; simpa using congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K => M i j) hz
      · simp [Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne, h.symm]
target_source: ∀ {K : Type*} [Field K] {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (t : K) (h : i ≠ j) (ht : t ≠ 0), (Matrix.single i j t : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) ≠ 0 ∧ Matrix.single i j t * Matrix.single i j t = 0
